newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF, NY Fed to discuss banks, forex - report.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF, NY Fed to discuss banks, forex - report.

text.p: Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs Takatoshi Kato will meet New York Federal Reserve chief William McDonough in the United States to discuss the supervision of Japanese banks and exchange views on currencies, a Japanese news service said on Wednesday.
Kato and McDonough are expected to agree to maintain the current trend of the stronger dollar against the yen, Jiji news service said.
Ministry of Finance (MOF) officials were not immediately available for comment.

The report said Kato has been on a business trip to Paris since September 9 to discuss emergency resources to deal with Mexico-type crises ahead of series of international meetings at the end of this month, including a Group of Seven (G7) finance ministers' meeting in Washington D.C.

Jiji said U.S. authorities have become suspicious about business activities of Japanese banks in the United States, following incidents such as one in which the New York trust unit of Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan (LTCB) failed to report securities-related deals.
